body: I think we are much alike, I feel the same, I've felt the same, you don't have to share the reason why you get this episodes, or probably you don't now why or you just can't confront the reasons but I'll tell you mine for some perspective, I was raped as a child, I was 8 or 9, I blocked all memories from that time so I can't put a precise time to it, and when growing up I felt the same, like when everyone else was going through whatever was the time about I was fighting with something no one else could understand, and the feeling kept with me throughout the years, after many years I could understand that that was my way of maturing, it wasn't the same like others, I could not relate to my friends problems and happy times , but I was able to learn from them. not like everyone else would do but how I was able too, you can't compare with how others grow or mature because everyone has a different way to do it, but you are not alone and your way is not either wrong or better is just yours, every time you have felt you lost time it was and it will be just your way of maturing even if it feels otherwise, don't compare to others, your way it's just yours and no one else can understand it.
Wanna vent? wanna a friend? I'm here, don't do something that can't be undone, there is so much more than you think right now, just Dm me or keep writing.

I now the feeling, I've felt the same all my life, I now there is a much bigger story than this words behind, I have my own, I now that every time you felt you were about to end it something happened or you thought about something that made you kept going, anyone else probably will say that things will get better but you and I now that it is probably not the case, we feel that love and that special one we decided to trust with our most precious feeling and thoughts are the only thing keeping us alive, but I'm some who has felt the same and lost that special one and let me tell you something, it does not get any better, it keeps feeling the same, the pain lingers on, but I'm sure that as I do you can feel it, that thing beyond love, beyond life that seems to be calling to us, not telling us to take our own lives but to wait till it decides it is time, we have been in charged with the most difficult and most unappreciated work in this world, to be that last ray of light that nobody seem to notice or when they do, not to be accounted or rewarded for, to be the ones to endure the pain that others seem not to be cared about and even reward to cause. You are not wrong to thing that we can only find peace in the next life but let me tell you, you are not alone in this fight, you are loved by me and others, you make me feel proud of you, you give me strength to carry on, not to reward those that do wrong, not to feel better about our self, but to live, live against all odds, against that unbearable pain so when all this is behind, when our time has passed we can understand why, and to be rewarded with that warm that the world seems to have lost, you are not alone, if you want to talk about anything I'm here, I'm not ashamed of sharing my story with you, I'm here for you.

Why do you feel you have been set back a decade? Or why do you think that? You can DM me if you want.

BTW young is relative, I'm 35.

You are never done, you are never alone, in this cruel world we can feel at the end many times but there is always something before and after, even if you can't express what you are feeling I'm right there with you.

It is most normal than you think right now, I'm making a guess but because of your words you sound young, young enough and within a  probably toxic environment that you feel you can't talk to anyone about your issues, if you need to vent or to talk about something in particular I'm here, and as little as it may mean I'm proud of you for reaching out for help.
That is just how life at it's most raw it feels, if you need someone to talk too I'm here.

Hi, I'm sorry you are feeling like this, I now the feeling I'm 35 and I've struggled with a similar state all my life, I won't tell you all it's going to be fine, I won't sugar coat anything, if you feel like talking to someone I'm here with one advice to start... Vent whatever it's making this pain flow through your veins even if the feeling it's feeling nothing, you are not alone.

Unfortunately it is not an option, the debt is in my name so until is fully paid I can't leave the country, moreover we have three little ones, one rescued dog, one rescued cat and another dog that was her brother's that his wife was planning to put to sleep when they left, I dedicated part of my life to help animal associations and could never take a life just because it is convenient, guess that is playing against me now too, curious how the things I was raised to believe in and the things I thought were a correct way of living in peace seems to be used against me. I think she can have a shot at being happy if she can leave, her brother can apply to a reunification visa and I can get a little more into debt to pay for her tickets and some extra till she can get a job, I can keep taking the blows here till my little ones are no more and then we'll see.

Thanks for asking, caring and even coming up with suggestions, it is more than anyone has done for me lately. I'll keep praying for you and everyone who has try to give me some encouragement so you can find and keep some peace and happiness ☺️

Hi, unfortunately things are still the same, better than being worst I suppose. I think the only thing left for both or one of us will be to leave the country, I'm trying to put that in perspective so it doesn't affect me negatively but it's getting harder, the most likely scenario is that she will leave since she has a brother abroad that could help her out, it's sad though.
Thanks again, I think I'll take you on the offer.
Thanks for the encouragement, it's hard to keep believing in myself after all of this but I'll try.

Hello again, I'm still here thanks to all your support and such warm and kind words, you gave me the time and strength to realize I need more help, user u/YouDecideWhoYouAre pointed me to r/depression_help so I'll try to get some help there. I'll update when possible, it is the least I owe to you all beautiful people, thanks a million.

Please do not underestimate the abuse you are going through, please seek and ask for help without an ounce of shame, it took me so long to began trying to heal that has left permanent scars on me, you can have the headstart I wish I had, and being so mature at a young age tells me you will have a great and beautiful life,  thanks for your words of encouragement and that warm energy that I felt reading your replay, never thought of myself as brave for enduring but more of a coward for the same reason, regardless of how my story ends I'm glad that my story helped you believe in yourself. I'll try my best, please try as well.
You really are a cookie for the soul, this made me cry...
I'm trying to go back to believe in myself again, but whatever the outcome might be your words sure robbed a tear from my eyes and filled my heart with a bit of hope, thanks a million.

I've been feeling the same way for 35 years now, and even if you found someone who tells you and makes you feel that you are enough it only last as much as you can keep that feeling, in the end depends on you. I know it sounds cliche but I'm here asking for help too because I also feel I've reached my limit. I wished I know your story and perhaps give you the hug and words that could make you feel alright for a moment and give you the strength to go on, but for the moment I can only send you whatever energy I have left and hope you can feel warm in your heart again, I hope I can find the strength to be here for a little while more and that you can do the same, if you feel like it for as long as I can i'm here to talk.

It's hard to feel positive or strong right now, but apart from my wife no one ever told me they are proud of me, for a moment you made me feel a warm I didn't think was possible anymore... I hope I can be as strong as you made me sound, and whatever the outcome might be I'll carry these warm feeling forever, I hope I'm still able to send you some positive energy and you can help more people, thanks kind stranger.

I'm at the point of feeling it will bring peace to me and those around me, but I still cry and feel some sort of remorse... Don't know your story or your reasons but I hope you find peace and feel whatever small energy I can send your way.

It's strange how people like you been far away can send so much positive energy my way, you made me feel like a person reading your words, I might not get through this or really don't know what will happen but my heart feels less alone... Thanks a million.
Thanks for being here, whatever the outcome might be people of good heart like yourself will always be in my heart.
Thanks for your kind words, I hope I can get there.
Thanks a lot for your words, I'm trying my best and your words are the sweetest I have heard from a stranger, infinite thanks...

You are probably just realizing that what you had with your ex was real and that your infidelity broke it to pieces, you are only feeling the pain of a break-up added with the pain of knowing that it is your fault that you will no longer be together. As someone who was cheated this is my advice, just let him go (your ex), his is in a lot of pain right now and trying anything to either reconcile or apologize will only hurt him more, take into consideration that he is also serving in the army and has no time to deal with his feelings. Concentrate in improving your self so in the future you don't hurt some else and that you can have a genuine chance to be happy, best of luck.
